dedupe_keys.name: junctions 11 capacity queue and delay modelling for roundabouts priority and signalised junctions trl software

description: Junctions 11 is the latest version of the TRL Software package for modelling roundabouts, priority junctions and simple signalised junctions. The product page says it models and predicts capacity, queues and delays at roundabouts, priority intersections and isolated signal-controlled junctions; at signalised junctions it evaluates known signal timings and can optimise stage lengths and cycle times to minimise delay, and it can now evaluate simple adaptive signals. Users can switch a junction between priority and signalised options and compare results in one package, and assess how one signalised junction affects an adjacent one. Coverage: junctions in the UK and worldwide; the page cites governments, regional transport authorities, consultancies and academic institutions as users. Format and access: Windows desktop software (Windows 10 or later), current version 11.2.0, with an online TRL Software portal; paid training courses run online. Cost: paid; licence prices were not read. Licence: proprietary. Caveats: the empirical capacity relationships behind the roundabout and priority models were not read. Simulation uses: junction capacity checks and delay estimates in road network scenarios, for example diverted traffic after a closure. Related records: TRANSYT (model-trl-transyt-traffic-signal-network-optimisation), from the same provider, optimises signal timings across networks.
